title: Identification of a glioma functional network from gene fitness data using machine learning.
authors: Xiang, Chun-Xiang; Liu, Xi-Guo; Zhou, Da-Quan; Zhou, Yi; Wang, Xu; Chen, Feng
journal: Journal of cellular and molecular medicine
one_liner_zh: 该文利用机器学习整合CRISPR筛选数据构建胶质瘤功能网络并预测预后标志物，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Glioblastoma multiforme (GBM) is an aggressive form of brain tumours that remains incurable despite recent advances in clinical treatments. Previous studies have focused on sub-categorizing patient samples based on clustering various transcriptomic data. While functional genomics data are rapidly accumulating, there exist opportunities to leverage these data to decipher glioma-associated biomarkers. We sought to implement a systematic approach to integrating data from high throughput CRISPR-Cas9 screening studies with machine learning algorithms to infer a glioma functional network. We demonstrated the network significantly enriched various biological pathways and may play roles in glioma tumorigenesis. From densely connected glioma functional modules, we further predicted 12 potential Wnt/beta-catenin signalling pathway targeted genes, including AARSD1, HOXB5, ITGA6, LRRC71, MED19, MED24, METTL11B, SMARCB1, SMARCE1, TAF6L, TENT5A and ZNF281. Cox regression modelling with these targets was significantly associated with glioma overall survival prognosis. Additionally, TRIB2 was identified as a glioma neoplastic cell marker in single-cell RNA-seq of GBM samples. This work establishes novel strategies for constructing functional networks to identify glioma biomarkers for the development of diagnosis and treatment in clinical practice.
abstract_zh: 多形性胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）是一种侵袭性脑肿瘤，尽管临床治疗近期有所进展，但仍无法治愈。以往研究侧重于基于各种转录组数据聚类对患者样本进行亚型分类。随着功能基因组学数据迅速积累，利用这些数据来解析胶质瘤相关生物标志物存在机遇。我们旨在实施一种系统性方法，整合高通量CRISPR-Cas9筛选研究数据与机器学习算法，以推断胶质瘤功能网络。我们证明该网络显著富集了多种生物通路，并可能在胶质瘤肿瘤发生中发挥作用。从紧密连接的胶质瘤功能模块中，我们进一步预测了12个潜在的Wnt/β-catenin信号通路靶基因，包括AARSD1、HOXB5、ITGA6、LRRC71、MED19、MED24、METTL11B、SMARCB1、SMARCE1、TAF6L、TENT5A和ZNF281。使用这些靶点进行Cox回归建模与胶质瘤总体生存预后显著相关。此外，在GBM样本的单细胞RNA测序中，TRIB2被鉴定为胶质瘤肿瘤细胞标志物。这项工作建立了构建功能网络以识别胶质瘤生物标志物的新策略，为临床实践中的诊断和治疗发展提供支持。
